verdict.rationale: Moneybird has a documented REST API with OAuth, personal tokens and contacts endpoints, plus MCP, CLI and webhooks. Nothing in the pack shows an endpoint or export for the general ledger, ledger entries, or the trial balance, in open formats or otherwise. This is a fair question for accounting software, so the absence of evidence means none, not na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull the full general ledger and trial balance through a documented API in open formats
